messages:
jo: Quick check from today's usability: people keep misreading 'Quiet period' and think it's per-user. Any thoughts on renaming?

frank: We heard 'Snooze' and 'Silence' in labs. I prefer 'Silence for' as a label (verb + duration) because it's clearer in form fields.

lina: Small UI nit: the preview shows time but not timezone. Users traveling saw wrong expectations. Maybe add a TZ pill 'UTC' collapsed behind tooltip.

sam: Also the preview list doesn't show channel ordering. Backend routing matters; we should show '#1 / #2' badge.

a11y-bot: Automated findings: 1) TZ tooltip non-focusable; 2) channel badges rely on color only; 3) timepicker traps keyboard focus.

jo: Proposal: change label to 'Silence for', add compact tz pill with aria-expanded, add ordinal badge for channels, and swap timepicker to segmented inputs to avoid focus traps.

frank: Agree. For badges use ordinal text + color (e.g., '1st') so not color-only.

lina: I'll update Figma frames with the pill and badge and add a11y annotations.

sam: I'll write e2e for tab order and tooltip Esc dismiss. Also provide accessible hex tokens for badge colors.

jo: Action items: Lina uploads frames by EOD, Sam adds tests, Frank updates copy in the guide, and I'll run a designbot re-check. Thanks.
